extracted.intended_audience: prospective and current MVC (community college) students
extracted.subtask_description: A college web page specifying term calendars, admissions and registration windows, add/drop/refund/withdrawal deadlines, graduation application dates, financial aid deadlines, and transfer application/reminder windows for students to follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awareness of key academic deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: It's important to know when your academic deadlines are. Make sure that you know when term start dates are, when the last day to enroll in a term is, and when the most important financial aid deadlines arrive so you can complete your college tasks on time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Dates & Deadlines Calendar and Academic Calendar to stay on top of term start/end dates, enrollment deadlines, and financial aid dates. This is an overarching expectation for students to plan their work and administrative tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: College application (admissions) windows
rubrics_metrics.description: College application dates mark the start and end of when students may apply to MVC for the upcoming term. Because MVC offers short-term courses during major semesters, application deadlines may end part-way through a term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply within the listed Admission Starts and Admission Ends dates for the term you intend to attend (table lists dates per Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter terms). Note: High school concurrent enrollment deadlines are different than general college student applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Know term start/end dates and holiday periods
rubrics_metrics.description: Term start and end dates and holidays are provided for each term (e.g., Spring 2026 starts Feb 17 and ends June 12; listed holidays and break dates accompany each term).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan coursework and personal schedules around the term start/end and holiday windows. Refer to the term-specific table for exact dates and scheduled holiday breaks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add, refund, and drop deadlines (including 'No W' vs 'With W')
rubrics_metrics.description: Add, refund and drop deadlines are applicable for most, but not all, courses. Tables list Add Deadline, Refund Deadline, and Drop Deadline (No 'W' and With 'W') for each term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check MyPortal for your specific class deadlines because some courses have different deadlines. Observe the listed Add, Refund, and Drop dates (e.g., Spring 2026: Add Deadline March 8; Refund Deadline February 27; Drop Deadline March 8 (No 'W') / May 15 (With 'W')). Missing these dates affects your enrollment status and tuition refunds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class registration appointment timing and priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration appointments are assigned based on a defined order of priority. Registration start dates mark the earliest possible registration appointments for that priority group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the posted General Registration and Priority Registration dates and the appointment display dates (appointments are displayed earlier than registration begins). Your ability to enroll will start on the specified date and time of your appointment. Tables list group I/II/III windows and appointment display dates per term.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree application and graduation deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual deadline to apply for graduation is April 1. Students may apply for earlier graduation if they anticipate completing coursework before the annual spring deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply within the term-specific graduation application windows (examples: To graduate in Summer 2024, apply April 2 - July 15; Fall 2024 apply July 14 - October 15; Winter 2025 apply October 16 - February 1; Spring 2025 apply February 2 - April 1). Commencement occurs once a year and graduates from every term are invited but not required to participate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial aid application and priority dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Key financial aid dates include FAFSA and CA Dream Act opening, Cal Grant priority and final filing deadlines, and the last day to file FAFSA for the current academic year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Observe and act by these dates: FAFSA and CA Dream Act open for next academic year on December 15; Cal Grant application priority deadline (date postmarked) May 2; Cal Grant final filing deadline for Community College Entitlement Grant (date postmarked) September 2; last day to file your FAFSA for current academic year (federal deadline) June 30. Missing these dates can affect eligibility and awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transfer application windows and reminders
rubrics_metrics.description: Transfer-related dates and tasks include applying for an Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT), UC and CSU application openings, UC TAG application window, transfer fair and other transfer-related events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the specified windows: Apply to receive ADT July 16 - October 15 for spring transfers; UC Admission Application opens August 1; Annual MVC Transfer Fair in September; Apply for UC TAG September 1 - 30; Apply for CSU Admission October 1 - November 30 (for fall); Apply for UC Admission November 1 - 30; Apply to receive ADT January 1 - February 15 for fall transfers. Also check email for important university admissions notifications (noted March 30) and note the Annual MVC Transfer Achievement Ceremony in May.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check MyPortal for course-specific deadlines and details
rubrics_metrics.description: For your specific class deadlines, check MyPortal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because not all courses follow the general deadlines, use MyPortal to verify add/refund/drop and other deadlines specific to individual classes to avoid missing action windows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review the annual timeline for comprehensive and priority dates
rubrics_metrics.description: For a more comprehensive list of important dates and deadlines, such as when priority registration occurs, review the annual timeline (links provided for 2026-27 and 2025-26 timelines).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the annual timeline PDFs to get a consolidated view of admissions, registration, financial aid, and other institutional deadlines that affect planning across terms.
